## Verification Checklist

Please ensure all the following checks pass before requesting a review:

- [ ] `npm test` passes completely (deterministic simulation unit tests).
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds without bundle errors.
- [ ] Tested in a desktop browser (Chrome / Firefox / Safari).
- [ ] Zero external binary assets added (maintains 100% procedural Three.js + Web Audio architecture).
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or personal file paths introduced.
- [ ] Documentation updated if applicable (`README.md`, `HELP`, or in-game journal).
